actions.action: Preserve arrival order across every reroute
actions.mechanism: Separate a case’s permanent waiting claim from its current team, tags, and queue location.
actions.implementation: Store immutable arrival_at and intake_sequence. Rank eligible, ready cases within each explicit urgency tier by that pair, never by transfer time.
actions.check: Reroute an older case twice; verify it still precedes newer eligible cases. Simultaneous arrivals must retain deterministic intake order.
actions.risk: Urgency tiers can starve ordinary cases; monitor their oldest waits.

actions.mechanism: Treat required language, product expertise, urgent qualification, and current roster capacity as assignment gates.
actions.implementation: Route automatic and manual assignments through one transaction that rechecks worker qualifications, roster version, and remaining capacity before reserving a slot.
actions.check: Race two assignments for one slot and change shifts during dispatch; reject over-capacity, off-shift, language-mismatched, and unqualified urgent assignments.
actions.risk: Stale qualification records can invalidate otherwise correct routing.

actions.action: Show why each case is waiting
actions.mechanism: Represent missing information and unavailable skills separately instead of hiding both behind an unassigned label.
actions.implementation: Record independent blockers for information, skill coverage, and capacity. Display missing fields, required skills, blocker age, and total age from arrival.
actions.check: Create cases with each blocker and both information and skill blockers; verify every reason appears and clearing one preserves the others.
actions.risk: Overly broad information requirements can unnecessarily block service.

actions.mechanism: Version routing requirements on the original case, preserving its waiting claim while preventing assignments based on superseded tags.
actions.implementation: Apply tag corrections atomically; retain arrival fields, record old and new values, invalidate pending offers, and requeue incompatible active assignments.
actions.check: Correct language while an offer is accepted; only an assignment matching the latest requirements may commit, with original arrival unchanged.
actions.risk: Repeated corrections can interrupt work; retain notes and correction history.

actions.action: Hold urgent cases safely when coverage disappears
actions.mechanism: Make missing urgent coverage an explicit escalation condition, never permission to relax qualification requirements.
actions.implementation: Require documented issue-based urgency criteria, excluding status and spending. With neither trained worker available, hold by original arrival and alert the shift lead.
actions.check: Run a shift with no eligible urgent worker: no assignment occurs. Adding qualified coverage releases eligible cases in preserved order.
actions.risk: Escalation cannot guarantee immediate qualified coverage or response.

actions.action: Reserve scarce skills through batch matching
actions.mechanism: Consider workers together so flexible staff do not consume work that available specialists could handle.
actions.implementation: Build eligible case-worker edges from the roster. Select cases by urgency and original arrival, then prefer least-flexible eligible workers without displacing older feasible cases.
actions.check: Submit simultaneous cases needing different skills; verify a feasible two-worker matching is used and an older feasible case is not skipped.
actions.risk: Matching rules need deterministic ties and bounded computation.

actions.action: Protect return from waiting for information
actions.mechanism: Keep the original service claim while temporarily excluding cases that cannot progress without specific customer information.
actions.implementation: Require a named missing item and next review time before applying the blocker. Remove it when resolved, returning the case using original arrival order.
actions.check: Resume an older information-blocked case beside newer eligible cases; confirm its original position and that unrelated cases progressed during its absence.
actions.risk: Unnecessary blockers can conceal delays; audit reasons and durations.
